_comment: Registers the todo app in the platform catalog. Apply with:
The whole batch is created in one transaction, in dependency order, so the
application may reference the infrastructure and secret store declared
Ids come from names: 'todo app' -> 'todo-app'. Keep the names as they are,
or the dependency and wiring ids stop matching.
Publish the artifacts first (Publish platform service, service: todo-app).
No credential appears anywhere in this file, and there is nowhere to put
one. The tenant supplies the password once, to the secret store; it is
written to that tenant's own Key Vault, resolved from there by ARM when the
server is provisioned, and delivered to the app as a Kubernetes Secret.

secretSets.name: todo database
secretSets.description: The PostgreSQL credential. Supplied once by each tenant: it provisions their database server and is delivered to the app. Stored in the tenant's own Key Vault, where the platform cannot read it back.

infrastructure.name: todo db
infrastructure.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Reads its admin password from the tenant's own Key Vault at deploy time rather than being handed one.

applications.name: todo app
applications.description: FastAPI + PostgreSQL todo service. Its database credential is read from a Kubernetes Secret, never from its own values.
